name: cascade_delete
description: In main.go, function deleteCustomer, the transaction explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer with `DELETE FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = ?`. This matches an application-level delete cascade, and it qualifies because the separate read endpoint `listOrders` reads from `orders` (joined to `customer`), so deleting those order rows permanently removes data that `/api/orders` would otherwise return.
